```{r}
# Replace 'path/to/your/spaceranger/output/directory' with the actual path
data_dir <- "/home/mattia/Thesis/111125ST_def/binned_data"

# Load the data
# The 'slice' argument is important for naming the spatial data in the Seurat object
spe_object <- Load10X_Spatial(data_dir, slice = "HE_Stain_Slice")

# --- Early Coordinate Swap (Invert X and Y) ---
# Swapping x and y right after loading to ensure all analysis uses transformed coordinates.
image_name <- names(spe_object@images)[1]
image_obj <- spe_object@images[[image_name]]

if (inherits(image_obj, "VisiumV1")) {
    coords <- image_obj@coordinates
    spe_object@images[[image_name]]@coordinates$imagerow <- coords$imagecol
    spe_object@images[[image_name]]@coordinates$imagecol <- coords$imagerow
} else if (inherits(image_obj, "FOV") || inherits(image_obj, "VisiumV2")) {
    if ("centroids" %in% names(image_obj)) {
        coords <- image_obj[["centroids"]]@coords
        spe_object@images[[image_name]][["centroids"]]@coords[, "x"] <- coords[, "y"]
        spe_object@images[[image_name]][["centroids"]]@coords[, "y"] <- coords[, "x"]
    }
    for (b in names(image_obj)) {
        if (inherits(image_obj[[b]], "Boundaries")) {
            new_b_coords <- image_obj[[b]]@coords
            spe_object@images[[image_name]][[b]]@coords[, "x"] <- new_b_coords[, "y"]
            spe_object@images[[image_name]][[b]]@coords[, "y"] <- new_b_coords[, "x"]
        }
    }
}
```

```{r}
# 1. Set the default assay to "Spatial" 
DefaultAssay(spe_object) <- "Spatial.016um"

# 2. Filter out all spots/cells where the total count (nCount_Spatial) is zero.
spe_object <- subset(spe_object, subset = nCount_Spatial.016um > 0)

spe_object <- SCTransform(spe_object, assay = "Spatial.016um", verbose = FALSE)
```

```{r}
# Visualize the spot counts over the H&E image
SpatialFeaturePlot(spe_object, features = "nCount_Spatial.016um")

# Visualize a specific gene (e.g., B2M)
SpatialFeaturePlot(spe_object, features = "OstDelta")
```

```{r}
# Sum UMIs for each gene across all cells
gene_umis <- Matrix::rowSums(spe_object@assays$Spatial.016um$counts)
# Sort genes by UMI count in descending order
sorted_gene_umis <- sort(gene_umis, decreasing = TRUE)
# Print the top 10 genes with the highest UMI counts
head(sorted_gene_umis, 10)

genes = rownames(spe_object@assays$Spatial.016um$counts)
gene_umis <- data.frame(UMIs = gene_umis, genes = genes)

# Reorder 'genes' based on UMI_count in descending order
gene_umis$genes <- factor(gene_umis$genes, 
                                     levels = gene_umis$genes[order(gene_umis$UMIs, decreasing = TRUE)])

# Create the bar plot, ordered by UMI_count, and remove x-axis labels
ggplot(gene_umis, aes(x = genes, y = UMIs)) +
  geom_col(fill = "blue", color = "black", alpha = 0.7) +
  labs(title = "Number of UMIs per gene", x = "Genes", y = "Number of UMIs") + scale_y_log10() +  # Apply log10 transformation to Y-axis
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(),  # Remove gene names from the x-axis
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),  # Optional: Remove ticks on the x-axis
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))  # Center the title

# Create the bar plot, ordered by UMI_count, and remove x-axis labels
ggplot(gene_umis, aes(x = genes, y = UMIs)) +
  geom_col(fill = "blue", color = "black", alpha = 0.7) +
  labs(title = "Number of UMIs per gene", x = "Genes", y = "Number of UMIs") 
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(),  # Remove gene names from the x-axis
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),  # Optional: Remove ticks on the x-axis
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))  # Center the title
```

```{r}
# Run PCA on the SCT assay
seurat_obj <- RunPCA(spe_object, assay = "SCT", features = VariableFeatures(spe_object))

# Run UMAP using the first 20 principal components (you can adjust the number of PCs as needed)
seurat_obj <- RunUMAP(seurat_obj, dims = 1:30, reduction = "pca")

# Find the nearest neighbors using the first 20 principal components
seurat_obj <- FindNeighbors(seurat_obj , dims = 1:30)

# Run the Louvain algorithm to find clusters (you can adjust resolution for more/less granular clustering)
seurat_obj <- FindClusters(seurat_obj , resolution = 0.4)  # Adjust resolution as needed

# Plot the UMAP
DimPlot(seurat_obj, reduction = "umap")
```

```{r}
# The pattern to match for Drosophila mitochondrial genes is '^mt:'
seurat_obj[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(seurat_obj, pattern = "^mt:")

SpatialFeaturePlot(seurat_obj, features = "percent.mt")
```

```{r}
# 1. Extract the normalized expression matrix (SCT-normalized data)
normalized_data <- GetAssayData(seurat_obj, assay = "SCT", layer = "data")

# 2. Calculate the Mean Expression per pixel (column)
# R's row/column functions are optimized for this.
# Since the matrix is (Genes x Pixels), we apply the function to the columns (margin = 2).
mean_expression_per_pixel <- colMeans(normalized_data)

# 3. Add the new statistics back into the Seurat object's metadata
seurat_obj$mean_expression <- mean_expression_per_pixel
```

```{r}
# Plot 1: Mean Expression
SpatialFeaturePlot(seurat_obj, features = "mean_expression", pt.size.factor = 1.2)

```

```{r}
# 1. Access the raw count matrix (the 'counts' slot of the RNA assay).
# This matrix has Genes (Features) as rows and Pixels (Cells/Spots) as columns.
raw_counts <- GetAssayData(seurat_obj, assay = "SCT", layer = "counts")

# 2. Identify the mitochondrial genes (using the Drosophila prefix "mt:")
mt_genes <- rownames(raw_counts)[grep(pattern = "^mt:", x = rownames(raw_counts))]

# 3. Calculate the total mitochondrial counts across the ENTIRE SAMPLE
total_mt_counts <- sum(raw_counts[mt_genes, ])

# 4. Calculate the total counts (UMIs) for ALL genes across the ENTIRE SAMPLE
total_all_counts <- sum(raw_counts)

# 5. Calculate the global mitochondrial percentage
global_mt_percent <- (total_mt_counts / total_all_counts) * 100

global_mt_percent
```

```{r}
# 1. Access the raw count matrix
raw_counts <- GetAssayData(seurat_obj, assay = "SCT", layer = "counts")

# 2. Identify the ribosomal genes (using the Drosophila prefix pattern '^Rp[LS]')
# This pattern matches genes starting with RpL or RpS.
ribo_genes <- rownames(raw_counts)[grep(pattern = "^Rp[LS]", x = rownames(raw_counts))]

# 3. Calculate the total ribosomal counts across the ENTIRE SAMPLE
total_ribo_counts <- sum(raw_counts[ribo_genes, ])

# 4. Calculate the total counts (UMIs) for ALL genes across the ENTIRE SAMPLE
total_all_counts <- sum(raw_counts)

# 5. Calculate the global ribosomal percentage
global_ribo_percent <- (total_ribo_counts / total_all_counts) * 100

# Print the result
cat(sprintf("The percentage of reads assigned to ribosomal genes is: %.2f%%", global_ribo_percent))
```

```{r}
# 1. Calculate the percentage for each individual pixel/spot

seurat_obj[["percent.ribo"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(seurat_obj, pattern = "^Rp[LS]")

# 2. Plotting the per-pixel percentage on the spatial image
```
